{{Top|leg}}
'''Seventh-stage bank-courier repulsor-trucks''' were colossal vehicles used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. Their wing nacelles utilized [[Seventh-stage bank-courier repulsor-truck engine|repulsor-truck engines]] in clusters of fifty for power.<ref name="AOTC ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
